title: Hexcrawl Backdrops
description:
Scene backdrops for hexcrawl play: 159 encounter places, one landscape for each of the 200 hexes and 20 fairy road and realm scenes. Every scene comes with variants for night, dusk, rain and mist, thunderstorm, winter, autumn, spring and campsites, which you switch by macro or chat command.

Scenes for the Dolmenwood RPG. English and German.

AI disclosure: all images are AI-generated. I made every one locally with FLUX.2 klein 4B from my own scene descriptions. No official Dolmenwood art, maps or text were used as input or reference.

I made these scenes for my own Dolmenwood campaign and share them for free in case other game masters find them useful. Some of the AI images are not perfect; if one does not work for you, just pick a different one.
